en: A colored panoramic view of an old city on a strait with many ships. In the foreground are dense low-rise buildings and several Ottoman mosques with domes and tall minarets. The waterway, filled with steamships and boats, is the Bosphorus. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as Constantinople and the Top-Hané (Tophane) district by the Bosphorus. There is also a modern website watermark over the image.
